description: Diagnose that the incident was caused by owner crash and relaunch handoffs, not graceful application quit handling.
Identify SSH/OAuth execution-pool infrastructure and remote disk pressure as the root cause rather than application logic.
Preserve diagnosable SSH executor errors instead of flattening orphaned tasks to a generic Application quit label.
Show that merge-gate stopped-before-completion failures are shutdown teardown symptoms, not gate evaluation failures.
Distinguish SSH/OAuth executing-phase infrastructure failures from misleading task-local package-manager warnings.
